notes.md: - **Revenue Neutral Rate (RNR):** The **Arvind Subramanian** (CEA) Committee, report **4 Dec 2015**, put the RNR (single rate that keeps revenue at current levels) at **15-15.5%** (15% preferred) and the **standard rate** at **17-18%**.

new.s: Under the GST composition scheme, at what flat rate do service providers pay tax?
new.x: Composition dealers pay 1% on goods and 6% on services, with no input tax credit.
new.angle: U0541 notes gap: composition rate for services 6%

new.s: Which of the following State taxes was subsumed in GST?
new.x: States gave up VAT, entry tax, luxury tax, entertainment tax and octroi when GST came in.
new.angle: U0541 notes gap: State taxes subsumed (VAT, entry, octroi)

new.s: What range of Revenue Neutral Rate (RNR) for GST did the Arvind Subramanian Committee (2015) recommend?
new.x: The CEA committee (Dec 2015) put the RNR at 15-15.5%, preferring 15%; 17-18% was its standard rate.
new.angle: U0541 web: #7 revenue neutral rate debate

new.s: Who headed the committee that recommended the Revenue Neutral Rate and the structure of GST rates in December 2015?
new.x: Chief Economic Adviser Arvind Subramanian headed the committee; it suggested an RNR of 15-15.5% and a standard rate of 17-18%.
new.angle: U0541 web: #7 RNR committee chair

new.s: Under which Article is GST levied and collected by the Union on supplies in the course of inter-State trade?
new.x: Article 269A covers GST on inter-State trade (IGST); it is shared as Parliament provides on GST Council advice.
new.angle: U0542 notes gap: Art 269A inter-State GST

new.s: Agricultural income tax is levied by the States under which entry of the State List?
new.x: Agricultural income tax is a State tax under State List Entry 46; corporation tax is Union List Entry 85.
new.angle: U0542 notes gap: agricultural income tax State List Entry 46

new.s: Which of the following duties is levied by the Union but collected and kept by the States under Article 268?
o: Excise on medicinal and toilet preparations
new.x: Article 268 covers stamp duties and excise on medicinal and toilet preparations; the States collect and keep them.
new.angle: U0542 notes gap: Art 268 medicinal and toilet preparations

new.s: Which Article requires the report of the Finance Commission to be laid before Parliament?
new.x: Article 280 sets up the Finance Commission; Article 281 lays its report before Parliament.
new.angle: U0542 notes gap: Art 281 FC report

new.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Under Article 293(3), a State needs the Centre's consent for fresh loans while any Union loan to it is outstanding.
2. Under Article 293(4), the Centre may attach conditions while giving such consent.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Article 293(3) requires the Centre's consent if a Union loan or guarantee is outstanding, and 293(4) lets the Centre attach conditions.
new.angle: U0542 notes gap: Art 293(4) conditions on consent

new.s: Who chaired the Commission on Centre-State Relations set up in 1983?
new.x: Justice R.S. Sarkaria chaired the 1983-88 Commission; its report led to the Inter-State Council (1990).
new.angle: U0542 notes gap: Sarkaria Commission chair

new.s: How much grant to gram panchayats did the Fourteenth Finance Commission recommend for 2015-20?
new.x: The 14th FC gave gram panchayats about ₹2.00 lakh crore; ₹2.36 lakh crore was the 15th FC's rural grant.
new.angle: U0543 notes gap: 14th FC gram panchayat grant (PYQ y985d522e91f angle)

new.s: What is the total amount of grants recommended by the Sixteenth Finance Commission?
new.x: The 16th FC recommended total grants of ₹9.47 lakh crore, of which ₹7.91 lakh crore is for local bodies.
new.angle: U0543 notes gap: 16th FC total grants

new.s: On which date was the report of the Sixteenth Finance Commission tabled in Parliament?
new.x: The report was submitted on 17 November 2025, tabled on 1 February 2026 and came into force on 1 April 2026.
new.angle: U0543 notes gap: 16th FC report tabled

new.s: When was the Fifteenth Finance Commission constituted?
new.x: The 15th FC under N.K. Singh was set up on 27 November 2017; the 14th on 2 January 2013.
new.angle: U0543 notes gap: 15th FC constitution date

new.s: Which period did the awards of the Fifteenth Finance Commission cover?
new.x: The 15th FC gave an interim report for 2020-21 and a main report for 2021-26.
new.angle: U0543 notes gap: 15th FC award period

new.s: Under the Sixteenth Finance Commission, what happened to the shares of the five southern States in tax devolution?
new.x: With the new GDP-contribution criterion, the shares of all five southern States rose under the 16th FC.
new.angle: U0543 notes gap: 16th FC southern States' shares rose

new.s: What kind of body is the Finance Commission of India?
new.x: The Finance Commission is a constitutional, quasi-judicial body formed by the President under Article 280.
new.angle: U0544 notes gap: FC quasi-judicial

new.s: Which matter was referred by the President to the Fifteenth Finance Commission under Article 280(3)(d)?
o: Disaster financing under the Disaster Management Act, 2005
new.x: Clause (d) covers any matter the President refers, such as disaster financing under the DM Act, 2005 for the 15th FC.
new.angle: U0544 notes gap: Art 280(3)(d) reference

new.s: The divisible pool as a share of gross tax revenue fell from 89.2% in the 13th FC period to about what level in the 15th FC period?
new.x: The pool fell from 89.2% (FC-13) to 82.1% (FC-14) and 78.3% (FC-15) as cesses and surcharges rose.
new.angle: U0544 notes gap: divisible pool share of gross tax

new.s: What did the Sixteenth Finance Commission recommend to improve transparency about the divisible pool?
o: Merging the GST Council with the Finance Commission
Annual CAG-certified disclosure of net tax proceeds
new.x: The 16th FC asked for an annual CAG-certified statement of net tax proceeds; it said capping cesses was not permissible.
new.angle: U0544 notes gap: CAG-certified net proceeds

new.s: What is Andhra Pradesh's share in horizontal devolution under the Fifteenth Finance Commission for 2021-26?
new.x: AP's share was 4.305% under the 14th FC, 4.111% (2020-21) and 4.047% (2021-26) under the 15th FC, and 4.217% under the 16th.
new.angle: U0544 notes gap: AP share 15th FC 2021-26

new.s: Under the Sixteenth Finance Commission, the share of grants in total Finance Commission transfers fell from 19.4% to about what level?
new.x: The 16th FC cut grants to local body and disaster grants only, so their share fell from 19.4% to 8.3%.
new.angle: U0544 notes gap: grants share 19.4 to 8.3

new.s: What is the allocation for Centrally Sponsored Schemes in the Union Budget 2026-27?
new.x: CSS allocation for 2026-27 is ₹5,48,798 crore, up 30.6%.
new.angle: U0544 notes gap: CSS 2026-27 amount

new.s: Which of the following criteria was used in the Gadgil formula (1969) but dropped in the Gadgil-Mukherjee formula (1991)?
new.x: Gadgil gave 10% to ongoing irrigation and power projects; Gadgil-Mukherjee dropped it.
new.angle: U0544 notes gap: Gadgil irrigation and power criterion

new.s: What weight did the Gadgil-Mukherjee formula give to per capita income?
new.x: Gadgil-Mukherjee: population 60%, per capita income 25%, tax effort 7.5%, special problems 7.5%.
new.angle: U0544 notes gap: Gadgil-Mukherjee per capita income 25%

new.s: According to the Economic Survey 2025-26, State capital expenditure rose from 2.17% of GDP in FY22 to what level in FY25?
new.x: The Survey credits SASCI loans for raising State capex from 2.17% (FY22) to 2.37% of GDP (FY25).
new.angle: U0544 notes gap: State capex 2.37% of GDP

new.s: How much is the devolution of taxes to the States in the Union Budget 2026-27?
new.x: Budget 2026-27 puts tax devolution at ₹15,26,255 crore within total transfers of ₹26,20,769 crore.
new.angle: U0544 notes gap: devolution 2026-27

new.s: How much disaster grant does the Sixteenth Finance Commission give Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: 16th FC grants to AP: rural local bodies ₹16,627 crore, urban ₹12,158 crore, disaster ₹6,125 crore.
new.angle: U0544 notes gap: AP disaster grant 16th FC

new.s: After the loss of the revenue deficit grant, what is Andhra Pradesh's revenue deficit in Budget 2026-27?
new.x: With the 16th FC ending revenue deficit grants, AP's revenue deficit is 1.1% in Budget 2026-27.
new.angle: U0544 notes gap: AP revenue deficit 1.1%

new.s: How much special infrastructure grant did the Sixteenth Finance Commission give urban local bodies for wastewater in cities of 10-40 lakh population?
new.x: The special infrastructure component is ₹56,100 crore; the Urbanisation Premium is ₹10,000 crore.
new.angle: U0545 notes gap: special infrastructure grant 56,100

new.s: What is the size of the one-time Urbanisation Premium under the Sixteenth Finance Commission?
new.x: The Urbanisation Premium is a one-time ₹10,000 crore for merging peri-urban villages into cities.
new.angle: U0545 notes gap: Urbanisation Premium size

new.s: About how much did the Fifteenth Finance Commission give local bodies as grants?
new.x: Local-body grants rose from about ₹4.36 lakh crore (15th FC) to ₹7,91,493 crore (16th FC).
new.angle: U0545 notes gap: 15th FC local body grants

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the 16th Finance Commission's basic grant to local bodies:
1. Half of it is tied to water and sanitation.
2. It is fully untied.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The basic grant (80%) is half tied (water, sanitation) and half untied; the performance grant (20%) is fully untied.
new.angle: U0545 notes gap: basic grant half tied

new.s: Which of the following is a non-developmental expenditure?
new.x: Defence and border roads are non-developmental; rural development, power and railways are developmental.
new.angle: U0546 notes gap: border roads non-developmental

new.s: In which year did Peacock and Wiseman put forward their hypothesis on public expenditure growth?
new.x: Peacock and Wiseman (1961) used UK data to show spending rises in steps (displacement effect).
new.angle: U0546 notes gap: Peacock-Wiseman 1961

new.s: The share of revenue expenditure in total Union expenditure fell from 88% in 2014-15 to about what level by 2026-27?
new.x: Revenue expenditure fell from 88% (2014-15) to about 77% of the total as capital spending rose.
new.angle: U0546 notes gap: revenue share 88 to 77

new.s: During 2014-24, total expenditure of the States was in which range of GSDP?
new.x: States spent 16.15-17.49% of GSDP during 2014-24, with revenue expenditure 80-87% of the total.
new.angle: U0546 notes gap: States spending % GSDP

new.s: What is the Union's effective capital expenditure in Budget Estimates 2026-27?
new.x: Effective capex = capex ₹12.22 lakh crore + grants for capital assets ₹4.93 lakh crore = ₹17.15 lakh crore.
new.angle: U0546 notes gap: effective capex amount

new.s: Effective capital expenditure in BE 2026-27 is about what share of GDP?
new.x: Effective capex of ₹17.15 lakh crore is 4.4% of GDP; plain capex is 3.1%.
new.angle: U0546 notes gap: effective capex % GDP

new.s: Union capital expenditure in Budget 2026-27 is about what share of GDP?
new.x: Capex of ₹12,21,821 crore (+11.5%) is 3.1% of GDP.
new.angle: U0546 notes gap: capex 3.1% of GDP

new.s: Which is the largest subsidy in the Union Budget 2026-27?
new.x: Food subsidy (₹2,27,629 crore) is the largest, followed by fertiliser (₹1,70,799 crore).
new.angle: U0546 notes gap: food subsidy largest

new.s: What is the total subsidy bill of the Union Government in Budget 2026-27?
new.x: Total subsidies are ₹4,54,773 crore; food and fertiliser make up 87%.
new.angle: U0546 notes gap: subsidy bill 2026-27

new.s: Major subsidies (food, fertiliser, petroleum) in 2026-27 are about what share of GDP?
new.x: Major subsidies of ₹4.11 lakh crore equal about 1.0% of GDP.
new.angle: U0546 notes gap: major subsidies 1% GDP

new.s: How many grades of decontrolled P&K fertilisers are covered under the Nutrient Based Subsidy scheme?
new.x: NBS covers 22 grades of decontrolled P&K fertilisers such as DAP, MOP and SSP; urea is outside it.
new.angle: U0546 notes gap: NBS 22 grades

new.s: Who was the Union Finance Minister when the Oil Pool Account was closed on 1 April 2002?
new.x: The Oil Pool Account under the APM was closed on 1 April 2002, when Yashwant Sinha was Finance Minister.
new.angle: U0546 notes gap: Oil Pool closure FM
